mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM ad_billing_schema_history WHERE version=#{version}
mapper.update: WITH due AS (SELECT event_id FROM WHERE delivery_state IN ('READY','SENDING') AND available_at <= clock_timestamp() AND attempts >= #{maxAttempts} ORDER BY available_at,event_id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE o SET delivery_state='DEAD',last_error='ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED' FROM due WHERE o.event_id=due.event_id
mapper.select: WITH due AS (SELECT event_id FROM WHERE delivery_state IN ('READY','SENDING') AND available_at <= clock_timestamp() AND attempts < #{maxAttempts} ORDER BY available_at,event_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE o SET delivery_state='SENDING',attempts=attempts+1,fence=fence+1, available_at=clock_timestamp()+(#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second') FROM due WHERE o.event_id=due.event_id RETURNING o.event_id,o.destination,o.partition_key,o.payload_json,o.fence,o.attempts
mapper.update: UPDATE SET delivery_state='PUBLISHED',published_at=clock_timestamp(),last_error=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND fence=#{fence} AND delivery_state='SENDING' AND available_at > clock_timestamp()
mapper.insert: WITH locked AS (SELECT event_id,attempts FROM WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND delivery_state='DEAD' FOR UPDATE), changed AS (UPDATE o SET delivery_state='READY',attempts=0,fence=fence+1, available_at=clock_timestamp(),last_error=NULL FROM locked l WHERE o.event_id=l.event_id RETURNING o.event_id,l.attempts) INSERT INTO (replay_id,event_id,actor,reason,previous_attempts) SELECT #{replayId},event_id,#{actor},#{reason},attempts FROM changed
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivery_state IN ('READY','SENDING')) AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivery_state='DEAD') AS dead, coalesce(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-min(created_at) FILTER (WHERE delivery_state IN ('READY','SENDING'))),0) AS oldest_seconds FROM WHERE delivery_state <> 'PUBLISHED'
